To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the proposed SR RCNN can effectively capture the contextual and literal information of the sentence, and the sentence-level encoding vectors can effectively model the intrinsic relations within sentences; (2) The attention mechanism can help to focus on the important information of the sentences; (3) the conditional random fields can effectively model the relations between the sentences and the labels.

(a) our proposed SR RCNN model achieves state of the art results on sequential sentence classification; (b) we show that the proposed model can be easily extended to incorporate attention mechanisms and conditional neural fields to further improve the results; and (c) the proposed method can be easily adapted to other tasks such as document classification and question answering.
